import json,re,subprocess,collections,concurrent.futures
packet=json.load(open('packet.json'))
records=[]
shapes=collections.Counter()
common=\"MATCH (r:Resolution {resolutionScope: 'document_disposition'})-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t)\\nMATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {workingGroup: 'RAN4'})\\nWHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '\\\"scope\\\": \\\"whole_target\\\"'\"
for item in packet['items']:
    question=item['question']
    fields=item['fields']
    doc=re.search(r'R4-\\d+',question)
    doc=doc.group() if doc else None
    if fields==['cr_pack','tsg_meeting']:
        shape='document_pack'
        query=f\"MATCH (t:CR {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\nRETURN DISTINCT p.crPackId AS cr_pack, p.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting\"
    elif fields==['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting']:
        shape='document_disposition_pack'
        query=f\"MATCH (t:CR {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+common+\"\\nRETURN DISTINCT d.dispositionCode AS disposition, m.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting, p.crPackId AS cr_pack, p.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting\"
    elif fields==['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause']:
        shape='document_clause_trace'
        spec=re.search(r'TS ([0-9.\\-]+)',question).group(1)
        query=f\"MATCH (t:CR {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\nMATCH (t)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {{specNumber: '{spec}'}})\\n\"+common+\"\\nRETURN DISTINCT d.dispositionCode AS disposition, m.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting, p.crPackId AS cr_pack, p.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting, s.sectionNumber AS clause\"
    elif fields==['document','disposition','wg_meeting']:
        shape='pack_documents'
        pack=re.search(r'RP-\\d+',question).group()
        query=f\"MATCH (t:CR)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack {{crPackId: '{pack}'}})\\n\"+common+\"\\nRETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS document, d.dispositionCode AS disposition, m.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting\"
    elif fields==['document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack']:
        shape='release_clause_documents'
        release=re.search(r'Rel-\\d+',question).group()
        clause=re.search(r'clause (\\S+) of',question).group(1)
        spec=re.search(r'TS ([0-9.\\-]+)',question).group(1)
        query=f\"MATCH (t:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {{releaseName: '{release}'}})\\nMATCH (t)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {{specNumber: '{spec}', sectionNumber: '{clause}'}})\\nMATCH (t)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+common+\"\\nRETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS document, d.dispositionCode AS disposition, m.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting, p.crPackId AS cr_pack\"
    elif fields==['final_document','disposition','cr_pack']:
        shape='revision_descendants'
        query=f\"MATCH (:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:REVISED_TO*1..]->(t:Tdoc)\\nMATCH (t)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+common+\"\\nRETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS final_document, d.dispositionCode AS disposition, p.crPackId AS cr_pack\"
    else:
        raise ValueError(item)
    aliases=re.findall(r'\\bAS\\s+(\\w+)',query,re.I)
    assert aliases==fields,(item['id'],aliases,fields)
    assert query.count('RETURN DISTINCT')==1
    records.append({'id':item['id'],'cypher':query})
    shapes[shape]+=1
assert len(records)==139
assert len({record['id'] for record in records})==139
normalized={re.sub(r\"'["'^'"']*'\", \"'VALUE'\",record['cypher']) for record in records}
assert len(normalized)==6,len(normalized)
def validate(pair):
    record,item=pair
    result=subprocess.run(['python3','query_graph.py',record['cypher']],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        return {'id':record['id'],'error':result.stderr or result.stdout}
    try:
        payload=json.loads(result.stdout)
    except Exception:
        return {'id':record['id'],'error':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr}
    if payload.get('columns')"'!=item['"'fields']:
        return {'id':record['id'],'error':payload}
    return {'id':record['id'],'rows':payload.get('rowCount',len(payload.get('rows',[]))),'truncated':payload.get('truncated',False)}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    checked=list(pool.map(validate,zip(records,packet['items'])))
errors=[result for result in checked if 'error' in result]
print(json.dumps({'query_count':len(records),'shape_count':len(normalized),'shape_counts':dict(shapes),'checked':len(checked),'errors':errors,'empty_ids':[result['id'] for result in checked if result.get('rows')==0],'truncated_ids':[result['id'] for result in checked if result.get('truncated')]},ensure_ascii=False))
if errors:
    raise SystemExit(1)
serialized=''.join(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n' for record in records)
assert serialized.count('\\n')==139
with open('queries.jsonl','w') as output:
    output.write(serialized)
print('WROTE queries.jsonl: 139 queries, 6 distinct query shapes; all helper executions returned the required columns.')
PY"
